name: Dual-Lobe Henyey-Greenstein Phase Function
definition: A scattering phase function modeling softer backward back-scattering peaks by blending two Henyey-Greenstein lobes: one for forward scattering and one for backward scattering.
summary: The Dual-Lobe Henyey-Greenstein Phase Function models light scattering by blending forward and backward lobes for realistic cloud aesthetics, differing from single-lobe models by capturing significant back-scatter.
